honest_summary: Part A falsified the premise: the long no-contact state is not a gait; it is a falling/sliding free-root trajectory with duty 1.0, no touchdown phase offset, no GRF closure, and catastrophic height loss. Part B also falsified the admissible-vault prediction: the periodic direct-collocation trajectory cannot keep the combined stance/posture demand under 0.9 cap, with a best reported combined ratio of 1.322776 at phi=0.85. The attempted dynamic table saturated posture torque throughout and refused at tick 206. F-G5, F-G7, and graph tests are green. The bipedal admissible-vault path is not established at this cap; the quadruped comparison becomes the architecture headline.
